entries.english: Open Kenya’s national and Kiambu extension referral pages from the country review.
entries.st: Bula maqephe a tšupiso a keletso ea temo a naha ea Kenya le a Kiambu ho tsoa tlhahlobong ea naha.
entries.ts: Pfula maphepha ya xikombo xa switsundzuxo swa vurimi ya tiko ra Kenya na ya Kiambu ku suka eka nhlelo wa tiko.
entries.ve: Vulani masiaṱari a ndaedzo dza nyeletshedzo ya vhulimi dza lushaka lwa Kenya na dza Kiambu u bva kha tsedzuluso ya shango.
entries.zu: Vula amakhasi okudlulisela ezolimo zokweluleka zikazwelonke zase-Kenya nezase-Kiambu kusuka ekubuyekezweni kwezwe.

entries.english: Open Kenya’s historical soil catalogue from the country review.
entries.st: Bula lethathamo la nalane la mobu la Kenya ho tsoa tlhahlobong ea naha.
entries.ts: Pfula khathaloko ya matimu ya misava ya Kenya ku suka eka nhlelo wa tiko.
entries.ve: Vulani khathalogo ya kale ya mavu a Kenya u bva kha tsedzuluso ya shango.
entries.zu: Vula ikhathalogi yomlando yenhlabathi yase-Kenya kusuka ekubuyekezweni kwezwe.

entries.st: Fumana litšupiso tsa keletso ea temo tsa Kenya
entries.ts: Kuma swikombo swa switsundzuxo swa vurimi swa Kenya
entries.ve: Wanani ndaedzo dza nyeletshedzo ya vhulimi dza Kenya

entries.english: Choose Kenya and open Agricultural extension to find the ministry and county links.
entries.st: Kgetha Kenya ebe o bula Keletso ea temo ho fumana lihokelo tsa lekala le tsa setereke.
entries.ts: Hlawula Kenya kutani u pfula Switsundzuxo swa vurimi ku kuma swihlanganisi swa vuholobye na swa khawunti.
entries.ve: Nangani Kenya ni vule Nyeletshedzo ya vhulimi u itela u wana zwitanganyi zwa muhasho na zwa khauṋthi.
entries.zu: Khetha i-Kenya bese uvula Ezolimo zokweluleka ukuze uthole izixhumanisi zomnyango nezesezifundeni.

entries.st: Hlahloba tšupiso ea nalane ea mobu ea Kenya
entries.ts: Hlola xikombo xa matimu xa misava ya Kenya
entries.ve: Tolani ndaedzo ya kale ya mavu a Kenya

entries.english: Choose Kenya and open the Soils reference. The catalogue describes historical estimates for national studies.
entries.st: Kgetha Kenya ebe o bula tšupiso ea Mebu. Lethathamo lena le hlalosa likhakanyo tsa nalane bakeng sa lithuto tsa naha.
entries.ts: Hlawula Kenya kutani u pfula xikombo xa Misava. Khathaloko yi hlamusela swiringanyeto swa matimu swa tidyondzo ta tiko.
entries.ve: Nangani Kenya ni vule ndaedzo ya Mavu. Khathalogo i ṱalusa dzinganyelo dza kale dza ngudo dza lushaka.
entries.zu: Khetha i-Kenya bese uvula inkomba yeZinhlabathi. Ikhathalogi ichaza izilinganiso zomlando zezifundo zikazwelonke.
